method_notes: mass-conserving reintegration flow, parameter-map mixing, 500k steps/5 seeds, engineered food/dissipation; exact vector species definitions
author_reported_results: Raw evolutionary activity food/dissipative > vanilla, but normalization by total matter reverses ranking; distinct parameter vectors do not establish heritable organisms
limitations: Five seeds; changes in total mass confound raw activity, external mutation/food/creature injections, species identity by exact parameter vector; no controlled functional heredity

method_notes: 20 runs of 2m steps, six gene-value component types, unnormalized cumulative vs shadow-normalized activity, subjective curve labels

paper_version: 2023 arXiv full preprint and 2025 journal source/appendix examined
reviewed_sections: Transient attractor periods and seed outcomes
method_notes: Genetic-programming selection among 2^140 rotationally symmetric Moore-neighborhood rules; 143-step cluster and 1556-step formation recurrences, sparse random initial conditions.
author_reported_results: Two of 140 isolated rotationally distinct 3x3 seed patterns follow a replication trajectory; populations require sufficiently large and sparse grids and eventually break down by collision or saturation.
limitations: Published phenomenon includes periodic exact-shape recursion but no independent multi-generation causal lineage tracing, no inherited new ecological functions, and selected rule was found using external novelty reward.

method_notes: Cell-level necessary-cause tracing aggregated into cluster-instance DAG under exact binary Outlier update rule; independently branching same-pattern offspring.
author_reported_results: Reported 31,959,320 cluster-instance nodes/65,552,995 edges over 20k ticks; c2 demonstrates 15 generations and includes multiple disconnected causal paths across offspring.
limitations: Study chooses exact-copy connected clusters, selected c0 seed and includes live-cell causes only; lineage of recurrent patterns is not evidence of evolved new function, resource metabolism or universal organismhood.

reviewed_sections: 4(a–f) virtual ALife mechanisms, artificial chemistries, morphogenesis and open-endedness
method_notes: A literature synthesis separating abstract life requirements (autopoiesis, agency, open-ended adaptation), generic organizational design, and concrete implemented substrate; compares ontology and alternative conceptual definitions.
author_reported_results: Author concludes existing virtual ALife does not satisfy all three proposed high-level life requirements, although many artificial systems demonstrate selected mechanisms or partially life-like properties.
limitations: Conceptual nonconsensus life definition rather than empirical experiment; assumes virtual life is possible for the analysis; no published new organism, behavioral measurements, simulation datasets or independent reproduction.

method_notes: Fixed physics P vs evolvable code B, probabilistic molecular binding and decay policies, hand-designed 65-opcode replicase; 100-trial parasite-control tests and four death-rule variants.
author_reported_results: Authors report 32/100 parasite evasions in probabilistic Stringmol versus 0/100 sticky binding, and decay regimes that select pathological immortal bound loops or extremely long costly molecules.
limitations: Replicase hand-seeded, mutations and resource accounting externally designed, more evolutionary activity does not show functional open-endedness, and experiment conclusions are author-reported with no code reproduction.

method_notes: Designed stringmol universal constructor with genome G, copier C, expressor E and inert payload P; 500 separate populated containers initialized with 50 of C/E/G each; lineages manually inspected for viable semantic takeovers.

paper_version: 2003 original accepted full 10-page ECAL LNCS 2801 paper
reviewed_sections: 3 Processor Description Language (structure and instruction sets)

method_notes: Genotype includes processor registers/stacks/queues, instruction-definition microprograms and replicator program; two human-written ancestors; five repeats per environment, 200,000 updates max population 20,000.
author_reported_results: Authors report changed instruction definitions and shorter replication gestation under selection; processor structures generally retain original majority >90%, and no observed superiority over fixed interpreters for tested rewarded tasks.
limitations: Universal processor primitives remain human-designed; seeded replicators, simple ecologies and externally rewarded computational tasks; small trial count and time window, no demonstrated unboundedly evolving semantics or life.

method_notes: Retrospective Stringmol engineering and scientific model reconstruction; variation=change inside model, innovation=model change, emergence=meta-model change; intrinsic if embodied in mutable code; type-2 reaction network is observer's extrinsic category.
author_reported_results: Authors describe mutated replicators and parasites as variable/intrinsically innovative functions, while reciprocal hypercycles require a network-level meta-model reclassification that is specifically EXTRINSIC. It is a conceptual mapping of previously reported experiments, not new measured model performance.
limitations: Classification depends on chosen initial model/meta-model, no fresh experimental samples or open-ended sustained rate provided; cannot imply internal creation of new interpreter primitives, self-maintenance, consciousness or objectively unbounded evolution.

author_reported_results: Authors report 12/20 extinction, eight survivor dynamics, costly self-scanning, altered binding, partner checks and mutation-mediated large copy/cleave rearrangements.
